description: Marc Cycling provides professional mobile bicycle repair, assembly, maintenance and diagnostic services at the customer's location across Broward County and South Florida. Service-area business: the mechanic comes to you.
businessModel: service-area business, no retail store, no public address
openingHours: Saturday and Sunday, 07:00-17:00 America/New_York (confirmado pelo proprietario em 27/07/2026 nesta sessao; contato por telefone/WhatsApp responde 7 dias)

serviceCallFee.policy: Texto oficial aprovado (29/07/2026): We charge a $75 service-call fee to come to you. If you approve the service, the full $75 is credited toward your total, so when we do the work, the visit costs nothing extra. Phone estimates are always free.

cancellationPolicy: Sem taxa para cancelar ou reagendar; NO-SHOW (reserva nao cancelada) paga o service-call fee de $75 (politica confirmada em 29/07/2026; valor do no-show amarrado ao service-call fee, trocar se o proprietario definir outro)
guaranteePolicy: Workmanship guaranteed; reclamacoes em ate 15 dias apos o servico sao resolvidas sem custo (aprovado em 29/07/2026)
customerPolicies: Cliente pode assistir ao servico; preparo: bike acessivel (garagem/entrada/lobby) e bateria carregada em e-bikes (aprovado em 29/07/2026). Politica de mau tempo: DESCARTADA pelo proprietario, nao publicar
